units.source_text: 凡是出身高贵的皇家子弟，看见皇上如此宠爱源氏公子，都忌惮他，大家对他敬而远之。

en.t: All the highborn members of the imperial family, seeing how deeply the Emperor favored Prince Genji, were wary of him and kept a respectful distance.

units.source_text: 只有头中将不被他所屈服，些些小事也都要同他争个胜负。

en.t: Only To no Chujo refused to yield to him, and even over trifles he would compete with him to see who came out ahead.

units.source_text: 与葵姬同母生的，只有头中将一人。

en.t: To no Chujo was the only one born of the same mother as Lady Aoi.

units.source_text: 他想：源氏公子只是皇上的儿子而已；

en.t: He thought: Prince Genji is merely the Emperor's son, after all;

units.source_text: 他自己呢，父亲在大臣中是圣眷最厚的贵戚，母亲是皇上的同胞妹妹，

en.t: as for himself, his father was a noble kinsman more highly favored by the Emperor than any other minister, and his mother was the Emperor's own younger sister,

units.source_text: 他从小受父母无限宠爱，哪一点比不上源氏公子呢？

en.t: and from childhood he had received boundless affection from both parents, so in what respect was he inferior to Prince Genji?

units.source_text: 在实际上，他的人品确也十全其美，无善不臻。

en.t: In truth, his character was indeed nearly perfect, lacking none of the finest virtues.

units.source_text: 这两人在色情上的竞争，无奇不有。

en.t: The rivalry between these two in affairs of love produced every sort of strange episode.

units.source_text: 为欲避免烦冗，恕不尽述。

en.t: To avoid tedious detail, I must ask forgiveness for not recounting them all.
